compatibility.detail: The fractal package AgentSchema accepts the optional lifecycle field (standing, owner or bounded) and the agent renderer emits it as a native lifecycle child, matching the agent KDL the daemon already validates and reads via declared_agent_lifecycle (which rejects any other value with invalid-agent-lifecycle). Program bundles inline the SDK, so the landing-program golden hash changes once on the next render; publishers republish program missions once with the new bundle. The factory kit still lowers lifecycle to AGENT_LIFECYCLE env until the factory pin moves past this change, so either path currently declares the same lifecycle.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: No user action is required. To declare a lifecycle from the SDK, set the lifecycle field; omit it to leave lifecycle undeclared.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous renderer, which drops lifecycle from SDK-rendered declarations; declarations published with a lifecycle child keep working on daemons that validate it.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes; lifecycle metadata does not change process behavior, restart policy, or ownership rules.

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes; the change is limited to the authoring SDK's AgentSchema and renderer plus a program-bundle golden whose hash covers inlined SDK bytes.

summary: The fractal package agent schema gains the optional native lifecycle field (standing, owner, bounded), rendered as a lifecycle child the daemon accepts
